Class StorageCubeIdx

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.StorageCubeIdx
public final class StorageCubeIdx extends Object
The geometry of a Storage Stack's 3 x 3 x 3 grid: where each of the 27 cells sits in the block, what box it occupies, and which one a player's reach ray hits first. Cells are separated by gaps, so the grid does not fill the block even when every slot is occupied.

Positions are computed at the block's layout rotation, which reflects cell coordinates about the grid's center rather than moving the contents between slots.
